H6600.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06599»; a word, answer, letter or decree:--answer, letter, matter, word.

H6601.def: a primitive root; to open, i.e. be (causatively, make) roomy; usually figuratively (in a mental or moral sense) to be (causatively, make) simple or (in a sinister way) delude:--allure, deceive, enlarge, entice, flatter, persuade, silly (one).

H6602.def: from «06601» and «0410»; enlarged of God; Pethuel, an Israelite:--Pethuel.

H6603.def: or pittuach {pit-too'-akh; passive participle of «06605»; sculpture (in low or high relief or even intaglio):--carved (work) (are, en-)grave(-ing, -n).

H6604.def: of foreign origin; Pethor, a place in Mesopotamia:--Pethor.

H6605.def: a primitive root; to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve:--appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-)grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

H6607.def: from «06605»; an opening (literally), i.e. door (gate) or entrance way:--door, entering (in), entrance (-ry), gate, opening, place.

H6609.def: from «06605»; something opened, i.e. a drawn sword:--drawn sword.

H6611.def: from «06605» and «03050»; Jah has opened; Pethachjah, the name of four Israelites:--Pethakiah.

H6612.def: or pethiy {peh'-thee}; or pthaeiy {peth-aw-ee'}; from «06601»; silly (i.e. seducible):--foolish, simple(-icity, one).

H6613.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «06601»; open, i.e. (as noun) width:--breadth.

H6614.def: of uncertain derivation; probably a figured mantle for holidays:--stomacher.

H6616.def: from «06617»; twine:--bound, bracelet, lace, line, ribband, thread, wire.

H6617.def: a primitive root; to twine, i.e. (literally) to struggle or (figuratively) be (morally) tortuous:--(shew self) froward, shew self unsavoury, wrestle.

H6619.def: of Egyptian derivation; Pithom, a place in Egypt:--Pithom.

H6620.et: from an unused root meaning to twist
H6620.def: from an unused root meaning to twist; an asp (from its contortions):--adder.

H6621.et: from an unused root meaning to open (the eyes)
H6621.def: from an unused root meaning to open (the eyes); a wink, i.e. moment (compare «06597») (used only (with or without preposition) adverbially, quickly or unexpectedly):--at an instant, suddenly, × very.

H6622.def: a primitive root; to open up, i.e. (figuratively) interpret (a dream):--interpret(-ation, -er).

H6623.def: or pithron {pith-rone'}; from «06622»; interpretation (of a dream):--interpretation.

H6624.def: of Egyptian derivation; Pathros, a part of Egypt:--Pathros.

H6625.def: patrial from «06624»; a Pathrusite, or inhabitant of Pathros:--Pathrusim.

H6626.def: a primitive root; to open, i.e. break:--participle

H6627.def: from «03318»; issue, i.e. (human) excrement:--that (which) cometh from (out).

H6628.et: from an unused root meaning to be slender
H6628.def: from an unused root meaning to be slender; the lotus tree:--shady tree.

H6629.et: from an unused root meaning to migrate
H6629.def: or tsaown (Psalm 144:13) {tseh-one'}; from an unused root meaning to migrate; a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men):--(small) cattle, flock (+ -s), lamb (+ -s), sheep((-cote, -fold, -shearer, -herds)).

H6630.et: from the same as (06629) used denominatively
H6630.def: from the same as «06629» used denominatively; sheep pasture; Zaanan, a place in Palestine:--Zaanan.

H6631.def: from «03318»; issue, i.e. produce, children:--that which cometh forth (out), offspring.

H6632.et: from an unused root meaning to establish
H6632.def: from an unused root meaning to establish; a palanquin or canopy (as a fixture); also a species of lizard (probably as clinging fast):--covered, litter, tortoise.

H6633.def: a primitive root; to mass (an army or servants):--assemble, fight, perform, muster, wait upon, war.

H6634.et: corresponding to (06623) in the fig. sense of summoning one's wishes
H6634.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06623» in the figurative sense of summoning one's wishes; to please:--will, would.

H6635.def: or (feminine) tsbadah {tseb-aw-aw'}; from «06633»; a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized for war (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship):--appointed time, (+) army, (+) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, war(-fare).

H6636.def: or (more correctly) Tsbiyiym {tseb-ee-yeem'}; or Tsbiyim {tseb-ee-yeem'}; plural of «06643»; gazelles; Tseboim or Tsebijim, a place in Palestine:--Zeboiim, Zeboim.

H6637.et: act part of the same as (06632)
H6637.def: feminine active participle of the same as «06632»; the canopier (with the article); Tsobebah, an Israelitess:--Zobebah.

H6638.def: a primitive root; to amass, i.e. grow turgid; specifically, to array an army against:--fight swell.

H6640.def: (Aramaic) from «06634»; properly, will; concretely, an affair (as a matter of determination):--purpose.

H6641.et: pass part of the same as (06648)
H6641.def: passive participle of the same as «06648»; dyed (in stripes), i.e. the hyena:--speckled.

H6642.def: a primitive root; to grasp, i.e. hand out:--reach.

H6643.et: from (06638) in the sense of prominence
H6643.def: from «06638» in the sense of prominence; splendor (as conspicuous); also a gazelle (as beautiful):--beautiful(-ty), glorious (-ry), goodly, pleasant, roe(-buck).

H6647.et: a root corresponding to that of (06648)
H6647.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of «06648»; to dip:--wet.

H6648.et: from an unused root meaning to dip (into colouring fluid)
H6648.def: from an unused root meaning to dip (into coloring fluid); a dye:--divers, colours.

H6649.def: from the same as «06648»; variegated; Tsibon, an Idumaean:--Zibeon.

H6650.def: plural of «06641»; hyenas; Tseboim, a place in Palestine:--Zeboim.

H6651.def: a primitive root; to aggregate:--gather (together), heap (up), lay up.

H6653.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to grip
H6653.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to grip; a lock of stalks:--handful.

H6654.et: contr from an unused root meaning to sidle off
H6654.def: contr. from an unused root meaning to sidle off; a side; figuratively, an adversary:--(be-)side.

H6655.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06654»; used adverbially (with preposition) at or upon the side of:--against, concerning.

H6656.et: from an unused root corresponding to (06658) in the sense of intentness
H6656.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root corresponding to «06658» in the sense of intentness; a (sinister) design:--true.

H6657.def: from the same as «06654»; a siding; Tsedad, a place near Palestine:--Zedad.

H6658.def: a primitive root; to chase; by implication, to desolate:--destroy, hunt, lie in wait.

H6659.def: from «06663»; just; Tsadok, the name of eight or nine Israelites:--Zadok.

H6661.def: plural of «06654»; sides; Tsiddim (with the article), a place in Palestine:--Ziddim.

H6663.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense):--cleanse, clear self, (be, do) just(-ice, -ify, -ify self), (be turn to) righteous(-ness).

H6664.def: from «06663»; the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity:--X even, (X that which is altogether) just(-ice), ((un-))right(-eous) (cause, -ly, - ness).

H6666.def: from «06663»; rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity):--justice, moderately, right(-eous) (act, -ly, -ness).

H6667.def: or Tsidqiyahuw {tsid-kee-yaw'-hoo}; from «06664» and «03050»; right of Jah; Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites:--Zedekiah, Zidkijah.

H6668.def: a primitive root; to glitter, i.e. be golden in color:--X fine.

H6670.def: a prim root; to gleam, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; by transf. to sound clear (of various animal or human expressions):--bellow, cry aloud (out), lift up, neigh, rejoice, make to shine, shout.

H6671.def: a primitive root; to glisten; used only as denominative from «03323», to press out oil:--make oil.

H6672.def: from «06671»; a light (i.e. window): dual double light, i.e. noon:--midday, noon(-day, -tide), window.

H6673.def: or tsav {tsawv}; from «06680»; an injunction:--commandment, precept.

H6674.et: from an unused root meaning to issue
H6674.def: or tsov {tso}; from an unused root meaning to issue; soiled (as if excrementitious):--filthy.

H6675.def: or tsovah {tso-aw'}: feminine of «06674»; excrement; generally, dirt; figuratively, pollution:--dung, filth(-iness). Marg. for «02716».

H6677.et: intensively from (06696) in the sense of binding
H6677.def: or tsavvar (Nehemiah 3:5) {tsav-vawr'}; or tsavvaron (Song of Solomon 4:9) {tsav-vaw-rone'}; or (feminine) tsavva.rah (Micah 2:3) {tsav-vaw-raw'}; intensively from «06696» in the sense of binding; the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound):--neck.

H6678.et: from an unused root meaning to station
H6678.def: or Tsowbah {tso-baw'}; or Tsobah {tso-baw'}; from an unused root meaning to station; a station; Zoba or Zobah, a region of Syria:--Zoba, Zobah.

H6679.def: a primitive root; to lie alongside (i.e. in wait); by implication, to catch an animal (figuratively, men); (denominative from «06718») to victual (for a journey):--chase, hunt, sore, take (provision).

H6680.def: a primitive root; (intensively) to constitute, enjoin:--appoint, (for-)bid, (give a) charge, (give a, give in, send with) command(-er, -ment), send a messenger, put, (set) in order.

H6683.et: from an unused root meaning to sink
H6683.def: from an unused root meaning to sink: an abyss (of the sea):--deep.

H6684.def: a primitive root; to cover over (the mouth), i.e. to fast:--X at all, fast.

H6685.def: or tsom {tsome}; from from «06684»; a fast: --fast(-ing).

H6687.def: a primitive root; to overflow:--(make to over-)flow, swim.

H6689.def: or Tsowphay {tso-fah'-ee}; or Tsiyph {tseef}; from «06688»; honey-comb; Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:--Zophai, Zuph.

H6690.et: from an unused root meaning to expand, breadth
H6690.def: from an unused root meaning to expand, breadth; Tsophach, an Israelite:--Zophah.

H6691.def: from «06852»; departing; Tsophar, a friend of Job:--Zophar.

H6692.def: a primitive root; to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish):--bloom, blossom, flourish, shew self.

H6693.def: a primitive root; to compress, i.e. (figuratively) oppress, distress:--constrain, distress, lie sore, (op-)press(-or), straiten.

H6694.et: a primitive root [identical with (06693) through the idea of narrowness (of orifice)]
H6694.def: a primitive root (identical with «06693» through the idea of narrowness (of orifice)); to pour out, i.e. (figuratively) smelt, utter:--be molten, pour.

H6695.def: or (feminine) tsuwqah {tsoo-kaw'}; from «06693»; a strait, i.e. (figuratively) distress:--anguish, × troublous.

H6696.def: a primitive root; to cramp, i.e. confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile):--adversary, assault, beset, besiege, bind (up), cast, distress, fashion, fortify, inclose, lay siege, put up in bags.

H6697.def: or tsur {tsoor}; from «06696»; properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous):--edge, × (mighty) God (one), rock, × sharp, stone, × strength, × strong. See also «01049».

H6698.def: the same as «06697»; rock; Tsur, the name of a Midianite and of an Israelite:--Zur.

H6699.def: feminine of «06697»; a rock (Job 28:10); also a form (as if pressed out):--form, rock.
